title: Indlela yokuFaka iSicelo seNqanaba leSASSA
description: Inqanaba elipheleleyo lokufaka isicelo senqanaba leSASSA ngalo mbongo wonke kunyaka 2026: liliphi inqanaba elifanelekileyo kwisimo sakho, yonke imifuno eyimfuneko, kufanele kuqhelwe phi, kwenzeka ntoni ngexesha lovavanyo lwemali, kunye nokuthatha ixesha elide kangakanani ukuvunyelwa.

author.name: Lucky Cungwa
author.credentials: Verified against official SASSA publications and the Social Assistance Act

seo.metaTitle: Indlela yokuFaka iSicelo seNqanaba leSASSA — Umkhombisela Ongqalileyo 2026
seo.metaDescription: Funda indlela yokufaka isicelo senqanaba leSASSA kunyaka 2026: khetha inqanaba elifanelekileyo, qoqa yonke imifuno, dlula kuvavanyo lwemali, yifake kwi-ofisi okanye nge-intanethi, ulandele isicelo sakho kude kube kuphunyezwa.

contentBlocks.title: Indlela yokuFaka iSicelo seNqanaba leSASSA
contentBlocks.description: Ukufaka isicelo senqanaba lolunto epheleleyo yentlulo yamashumi amaninzi, kwaye uninzi lwamaphupha luhlehla ngenxa yemifuno engafikanga okanye ukukhetha inqanaba — hayi ngenxa yokuba awufanelekile. Le nkqubo ikunceda ukukhetha inqanaba elifanelekileyo, uqoqe yonke imifuno, uthumele isicelo sakho, ulilandele kude kube kukhokelwa.

contentBlocks.text: Nyaka wonke amawaka amaninzi oMzantsi Afrika afaka isicelo ngeqanaba lolunto, kwaye inxalenye enkulu yesicelo ihlehla okanye iyalelwa ngenxa yezizathu ezinokuthintekwa: kukhethwe inqanaba elingafanelekileyo, imifuno ayifikanga, okanye uvavanyo lwemali lubonakalise ingeniso engafakwanga. Le nkqubo iqhuba inkqubo epheleleyo yeendlela zokuqhubekela phambili ezifana neendlela zabaDala, abaNgezifo, kunye nendlela yokuSekela uMntwana, kunye nenqubo ye-intanethi yeSRD R370 grant.

Le nkqubo yilowo nalowo ufakeleyo isicelo sokuqala, okanye uvakalishe kwakhona emva kwenguquko yobomi, okanye unceda umntu osapho ngale nkqubo. Isicelo sakho sevalelwe ngaphambili, funda inkqubo yokukhangisa endaweni yoko.

Ngaphambi kokuqoqa imifuno, qinisekisa liphi inqanaba elifanelekileyo kwisimo sakho. Ukufaka isicelo senqanaba elingafanelekileyo kuchitha iiveki — isicelo sizohlolwa ngokweemfuno zelo nqanaba kwaye sivalwe ukuba zingafanelekanga. Sebenzisa lo mboniso weendlela eziphambili kunye neendlela zangoku:

rows: Abantu baseNtla Mzantsi abadala ngaphezu kweminyaka engama-60 abadlula kuvavanyo lwemali
Abantu abaneminyaka 18-59 abanegciwane lokuphila okanye ngqondo qinisekiswa yiimeko zokuphila
Abakhathali abaphambili beentsana abangaphantsi kweminyaka engama-18 abadlula kuvavanyo lwemali
Abazali be-foster ababekwe yinkundla yeentsana ababekwe phi
Abakhathali beentsana ezineentloko ezinkulu ezifuna ukunyangwa ngexesha elipheleleyo
Amaqhawe adala oMkhosi woLwa nomkhosi weKhole abaneminyaka engama-60 kunye
Abamkeli beendlela abafuna ukunyangwa ngexesha elipheleleyo
Abantu abangasebenzi abaneminyaka 18-60 abangenayo ingeniso okanye inkxaso (bcwele nge-intanethi)
contentBlocks.caption: Iindlela ezinkulu zeSASSA neendlela zangoku zangemveliso

contentBlocks.text: Inqanaba ngalinye elikwi-Library yeNqanaba lithetha iimfuno zokufaneleka. Am modeli amabini: akunakwenzeka ufake isicelo leNqanaba labaDala ukuba uneingeniso ephezulu kunqanaba, kwaye akunakwenzeka uthole iSRD R370 ukuba uthola i UIF, inkxaso ye NSFAS, okanye nayiphi na indlela lolunto. Xa iindlela zimbini zibonakala zifanelekile — umzekelo, usapho olunayo inzuzo yokunakekela abazali kunokufaneleka kunye neendlela zokuSekela uMntwana (njengabakhathali) neendlela zabaDala — ungaqhuba isicelo esinye nganye ukuba uhlaniyelwe kwiimfuno zalo.

steps.title: Khangela ubunakho bakho ngokucokisekileyo
steps.description: Funda iimfuno ezikhethekileyo zenqanaba lakho — iminyaka, izintloko zemali, imithetho yokuhlala, kunye neemfuno zonyango. I-Library yeNqanaba kunye neemfuno zokufaneleka zihlela nganye nganye.

steps.title: Qoqa yonke imifuno yendalo
steps.description: Qoqa imifuno yendalo kunye neekhophi zokukhuphela zayo yonke into ebhalwe kuluhlu lwemfuno ngezantsi. Imifuno engafikanga yeyokuqala kwiindaba zokuphinda uye khona kunye neengozi.

steps.title: Tyelela iofisi yakho yeSASSA esecaleni
steps.description: Iindlela zokuqhubekela phambili kufuneka zenziwe ngubomi. Fika ngasemva — iikhonkci ziqala ngaphambi kwexesha lokuvula. Akukho ndlela yokubhalisa, kodwa nezinye iofisi zisebenzisa inkqubo yokubhalisa uvavanyo lweendlela.

steps.title: Gcwalisa isicelo nomntu ophilayo
steps.description: Umphathi weSASSA ugcwalisa ifomu yawo kunye nawe. Ungayixhomeki ngaphambi kokuba uqinisekise ukuba yonke into ilungile. Iminwe yakho izothwa njengenxalenye yokuqinisekisa ubunikazi.

steps.title: Ukwamkelwa uvavanyo (elikhethekileyo lenqanaba)
steps.description: Iindlela zezifo kunye zeCare Dependency zifuna uvavanyo lokuphila lwabantu. Umphathi uza kubhalisa uvavanyo lwakho okanye akuthumele kugqirha waselaphini. Imicimbi yoshishino, ukwehlukana, kunye nokuhlola ingeniso kwenziwa kwiinkqubo zasekhemphalini.

steps.title: Yamkela i-risidi yakho elinemveliso
steps.description: Uza kufumana i-risidi enombolo yokulandelela. Yichuphe uphinde uligcine liphilile — uyafuneka le numeri ukukhangela imeko kunye nokulandela.

steps.title: Landela isicelo sakho
steps.description: Khangela inqanaba nge-WhatsApp (082 046 8553), ngocwebo (0800 60 10 11), okanye kwi-ofisi yakho esecaleni usebenzisa inombolo yokulandelela. Ukuqhubekeka kunokuthatha kude kube kwenye inyanga.

steps.title: Yamkela isigqibo kunye nokukhokelwa kokuqala
steps.description: Ukuba uvunyelwe, iindlela zibuyiselwa kunyuba isicelo sakho. Ukuba sivalwe, uza kufumana izizathu zombhalo kwaye ukwazi ukukhangisa ngaphakathi kweentsuku ezine-90.

items: Iindawo zeSASSA eziphambili: yonke indlela eqhubekayo (abaDala, aBangezifo, uSekelo lweMntwana, uNakekelo lweFoster, uNakekelo lweCare Dependency). Le yindlela eyodwa yeendlela.
Nge-intanethi ku srd.sassa.gov.za: iindlela zeSRD R370 kuphela. Inkqubo yonke ithatha malunga nemizuzu eli-10 kwaye idinga inombolo yakho yesazisi, ulwazi lokunxibelelana, kunye nemali ebhankini.
WhatsApp 082 046 8553: iindlela zeSRD R370 kunye nemibuzo yobume.
Ukutyelela ekhaya: ukuba ulele phantsi okanye unzima kakhulu ukuhamba, celisa umntu osapho ukulungisa ukutyelela ekhaya ngayo ofisi yakho.

documents.label: Isazisi sakho se-13-digit esinebhakhodi yaseNtla Mzantsi okanye ikhadi eliphilileyo
documents.notes: Izazisi zexesha elifutshane ziyamkelwa ngelixa ulinde isazisi

documents.label: Ubufakazi bokuhlala (ibhili yamanzi, i-afidhavithi, okanye incwadi yombhunga)
documents.notes: Ukuba uhlala kwindawo yabantu abahlala ngaphandle, incwadi yoqinisekiso yoLuntu inokusebenza

documents.label: Iinkqubo zebhanki zokugqibela zii-3inyanga
documents.notes: Ifuneka ukuba unebhanki; ibonisa uvavanyo lwemali indawo yemali yangempela

documents.label: Ibhasi yoshishino (ukuba uhlukaniswe) okanye isigqibo soshishino
Iindlela zokukhokela okanye incwadi yomenzi (ukuba usebenza)
Ifomu ye-UI-19 evela kuMmandla woMsebenzi (ukuba uye wasebenza)
Amabhesishezi ezintsana (indlela yokuSekela uMntwana, isicelo seCare Dependency)
Ubufakazi bokuhlola esikolweni (intsana ezi-7-18 kwiNqanaba yokuSekela uMntwana)
documents.notes: Iyafuneka kamva; umntu onakekela umntwana kufuneka aqinisekise ukubhalisa esikolweni kunyaka wonke

documents.label: Ungqinisiso lokuphila / incwadi yokuthumela (iindlela zezifo, uNakekelo lweCare Dependency)
documents.notes: Uvavanyo lwabantu lungenzelwa yiSASSA, kodwa zisa nayo yonke imbekelo yokuphila ekhona

documents.label: Isigqibo senkundla esibeka umntana esikhathini sakho (indlela yeFoster Care)

contentBlocks.text: Ininzi yeendlela eziqhubekayo zivavanywa ngokuvavanya imali — ukuvavanya ingeniso yakho kunye neempahla ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba udinga ngokwenene inkxaso. Ingeniso yakho oyedwa, kunye, ukuba uhlukaniswe, ingeniso yomfazi, ibaliswa kunye. Iimpahla ezifana neendlela zokuhlala ziqwalaselwa. Iinqanaba zitshintsha ngonyaka; inkqubo yethu yokufunda ukuqonda ukuhlola imali ibonisa iinzuzo zangoku kunye nezibonelo ezisebenzayo.

contentBlocks.title: Faka Yonke into
contentBlocks.text: Ungafihli ingeniso okanye iibhanki. I-SASSA iqinisekisa izinto ezifakwe kwiibhanki kunye neendawo zokusebenza, kwaye ingeniso engafakwanga etholwe kamva iholela ekuphunyezweni kunye nemfuno yokukhuphela. Ukufaka ingeniso ngokunyanisekileyo kunokushiya ukufaneleka.

rows: Ifomu igcwalisiwe, i-biometric ilandwe, i-risidi inikwe inombolo yokulandelela
Isazisi, imeko yoshishino, ingeniso, kunye nokuhlola kwindawo kugqitywa
Uhlalo kunye nogqirha waselaphini; iziphumo zidityaniswa nesigqibo
Isicelo sivunyelwe okanye sivalwe nezizathu zombhalo
contentBlocks.caption: Inkqubo eqhelekileyo yokucubungula isicelo sendlela eqhubekayo

contentBlocks.text: Akukho mali oyikhokelayo nakweyiphi na inqanaba. Ukuba umntu ofuna imali ukukhawulezisa isicelo — kunye nabamkeli ababizwa ngokuba ngabantu ngaphandle kweendawo zeSASSA — babike kumgama wokungabikho ukuthembeka ku 0800 601 011.

faqs.question: Ndingafaka isicelo nge-intanethi senqanaba leSASSA?
faqs.answer: Kuphela inqanaba yeSRD R370 ivumela izicelo ezizimeleyo nge-intanethi, ku srd.sassa.gov.za. Yonke indlela eqhubekayo ifuna ukutyelela iofisi ngobomi kuba i-biometric kunye nemifuno yendalo kufuneka iqinisekiswe.

faqs.question: Ilixabiso elifanelekileyo lokufaka isicelo?
faqs.answer: Akukho nto. Yonke inkonzo yeSASSA yimahala. Babike nabafuni mali yokufaka isicelo, ukukhawuleza, okanye iifomu kumgama wokungabikho ku 0800 601 011.

faqs.question: Ukuvunyelwa kuthatha ixesha elingakanani?
faqs.answer: Kude kube kunye neentsuku ezintathu ngokomthetho. Izicelo ezilula ngamanye amaxesha zigqitywa ngokukhawuleza; ezifuna uvavanyo lokuphila zithatha ixesha elide. Iindlela zibuyiselwa kunyuba isicelo sakho ngaphandle kokuba inkqubo yathatha ixesha elingakanani.

faqs.question: Ndingafaka isicelo kwiindlela ezimbini ngaxeshanyeni?
faqs.answer: Ewe, ukuba uhlaniyelwe ngokwenene kwiimfuno zenqanaba ngalinye — umzekelo, iNqanaba labaDala kunye neNqanaba yokuSekela uMntwana njengomkhathali. Akunakwenzeka uthole iindlela ezihlanganisiweyo ezifana neendlela zezifo kunye neendlela zabaDala ngaxeshanyeni.

faqs.question: Kuba ndingenasazisi?
faqs.answer: Faka isicelo sesazisi sexesha elifutshane kwiNdlu yabantu kwanango — iSASSA iyamkela izazisi zexesha elifutshane. Ukutyelela ekhaya kwabafuni abangenako ukuhamba kunokulungiswa ngayo ofisi yakho.

faqs.question: Isicelo sam sivalwe. Kufanele ndenzoni?
faqs.answer: Funda isizathu sokuvalelwa kwincwadi yakho, uze ubeke isicelo sokukhangisa ngaphakathi kweentsuku ezine-90. uninzi lwamaphupha luhlehla xa imifuno efanelekileyo ivalwe.

faqs.question: Umntu unokufaka isicelo endaweni yam?
faqs.answer: Ewe. Umntu owugunyizileyo (proxy) unokufaka isicelo senqanaba endaweni yakho kunye nencwadi yegunya kunye nezazisi zababini. KuSRD grant, izicelo kufuneka zenziwe ngesazisi sakho kunye nenombolo yocingo.

faqs.question: Xa ndifuna ukuphinda ndifake isicelo okanye ndivuselele?
faqs.answer: Iindlela eqhubekayo ziqhubeka ngaphandle kokuvuselela kodwa zihlolwa ngamaxesha athile. Iindlela zeFoster Care ziphela kunye nesigqibo senkundla ngasinye kwaye kufuneka zivuselelwe ngaphambi kokuphela. Inqanaba leSRD ihlolwa qho ngenyanga ngokuzenzekelayo.
